To effectively manage the risks associated with energy manage- ment, the company is undertaking the fol- lowing approaches: 1.Energy Efficiency efforts: Implementing energy-efficient tech- nologies, equipment upgrades, and pro- cess optimization to minimize energy con- sumption. 2. To reduce reliance on non-renewable en- ergy sources. 3. Renewable Energy Integration: Exploring and investing in re- newable energy sources, such as so- lar and Green Hydro- gen to diversify the energy mix and de- crease dependence on fossil fuels.

Risk: Negative Finan- cial Implications: Inefficient energy consumption can lead to higher en- ergy costs, im- pacting the company's profit- ability. Opportunity: Adopting energy- efficient practices and integrating renewable energy sources can re- sult in cost sav- ings over the long term.
Prices of the Im- ported Raw Mate- rials are highly volatile. Further volatility in the seg- ments where the Company's prod- ucts are sold is al- ways a matter of concern.
